messages:
morgan: PTAL - addressed the requested routing/backoff nits, added smoke instructions and a suggested canary window. CI is green locally but e2e has been flaky so I didn't auto-schedule.

sara: thanks—will skim in a bit. did you change the default log level? we prefer INFO for canary logs.

morgan: yep set default to INFO in the config and added an explicit env override for canary: `LOG_LEVEL=info`.

ash: quick glance — one test name looks misleading: `test_timeout_behavior` should be `test_backoff_timeout` to match the fixture. otherwise looks good.

morgan: renamed the test and pushed. smoke command in PR description now:
```
./scripts/smoke --env=staging --target=runtime --timeout=10m
```

jake: can you add the canary window we'd like ops to monitor? 6h preferred, starting on the rollout slot.

morgan: added canary window and the fallback policy snippet to the PR description:
```
canary_window: "2026-03-22T14:00:00-07:00/6h"
fallback_policy:
  - model: "redwood/gpt-small-quant"
    max_qps: 50
```

ci-bot: CI: 42/43 tests passed — `test_integration_timeout` flaky, rerunning.

ci-bot: CI: rerun passed, all checks green :white_check_mark:

sara: :thumbsup: I can be merge custodian for the 14:00 PST slot, will watch dashboards and call rollback if error rate > 2%.

ash: PTAL now that the test rename is in. lgtm from me.

morgan: great — scheduling canary for 2026-03-22 14:00 PST, tagging @sara as custodian and @ash for on-call review. thanks all! :tada:
